cards.text: God's seven angels have just poured out seven bowls of His wrath, and with the last one, God remembered Babylon the great (Revelation 16:1, 19). Now one of those seven angels comes to John, the one seeing this vision (Revelation 1:9). He says, "Come, I will show you the punishment of the great prostitute, who sits on many waters."
The angel says the kings of the earth were immoral with her.

cards.question: The angel says those who dwell on the earth were ___ with the wine of the great prostitute's immorality.

cards.text: Then the angel carries John away in the Spirit into a wilderness, where he sees a woman sitting on a scarlet beast. Talk about a trip you don't get to pack for!

cards.question: True or false: the scarlet beast the woman sits on is covered with names that honor God.

cards.text: And this beast has seven heads and ten horns. Friend, I've got ONE head and I still lose track of my hat.

cards.question: The woman on the scarlet beast is adorned with gold and precious stones and pearls. What is she dressed in?
The woman on the scarlet beast holds a golden cup in her hand. What is it full of?

cards.text: Then John sees a mysterious name written on the woman's forehead.

cards.question: The name written on the woman's forehead starts with a city. Which city?
True or false: the name on the woman's forehead also calls her the mother of prostitutes and of the abominations of the earth.

cards.text: John can see that the woman is drunk with the blood of the saints and witnesses for Jesus. I think this one hurts.
John has seen a LOT in this vision already. This sight still leaves him utterly amazed.

cards.question: True or false: when the angel sees John so amazed, he offers to tell John the mystery of the woman and the beast that carries her.

cards.text: First, the beast. The angel says it was, and now is no more, but is about to come up out of the Abyss.

cards.question: The angel says that after the beast comes up out of the Abyss, it will go to its ___.

cards.text: The angel says some people on earth will marvel when they see the beast that was, and is not, and yet will be.

cards.question: Which people on earth does the angel say will marvel when they see the beast?

answers.text: those not written in the Book of Life

cards.text: The angel says, "This calls for a mind with wisdom." Friend, when an angel says that, you put the whisk DOWN and lean in.
Then the angel explains that the beast's seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman sits.
Then the angel adds, "There are also seven kings. Five have fallen, one is, and the other has not yet come."

cards.question: True or false: the angel says the last of the seven kings, the one who has not yet come, will stay for a long time.
The angel says the beast that was, and now is not, is king number ___ and belongs to the other seven.
The angel says the beast's ten horns are ten kings who haven't received a kingdom yet. How long will they have authority as kings along with the beast?

cards.text: Ten kings, and the angel says they all have one purpose. Friend, the dead batteries I shared that drawer with couldn't agree on ANYTHING.

cards.question: The angel says the ten kings have one purpose: to yield their power and authority to the ___.

cards.text: Then the angel says the ten kings will make war against the Lamb, who is Jesus (John 1:29).

cards.question: True or false: the angel says the Lamb will triumph over the ten kings.
Why does the angel say the Lamb will triumph over the ten kings?

answers.text: He rules over all lords and kings
the ten kings turn on each other
the angels fight the battle for Him

cards.question: True or false: the angel says the Lamb will be accompanied by His called and chosen and faithful ones.
The angel goes back to the many waters where the prostitute was sitting. What does he say those waters are?

answers.text: peoples and multitudes and nations and tongues
the seas and rivers of the whole earth
the tears of the saints and witnesses

cards.text: The angel says the ten horns and the beast will hate the prostitute. They will leave her desolate and naked, and they will eat her flesh and burn her with fire.

cards.question: Who does the angel say has put it into the hearts of the ten kings to give their kingdom to the beast?

cards.text: So the ten kings and the beast may look like they're in charge, but the angel says it's God's purpose they're carrying out, until the words of God are fulfilled.

cards.question: Last thing the angel explains is the woman herself. What does he say she is?

answers.text: the great city that rules the kings of the earth
a queen from a land far beyond the sea
an idol the kings of the earth set up

cards.text: And that's where we'll pause, friend, because this story is far from over.
